lines.text: What did you do last Saturday afternoon?
lines.speaker: Ming

lines.text: I went to a movie, but the first show was full.
lines.speaker: Liv

lines.text: What did you do after you saw that?
lines.speaker: Ming

lines.text: First, I bought a ticket for the next show.
lines.speaker: Liv

lines.text: Did you have to wait there for long?
lines.speaker: Ming

lines.text: About an hour, so I went to a bookshop nearby.
lines.speaker: Liv

lines.text: How was the movie in the end?
lines.speaker: Ming

lines.text: It was funny. I was glad I stayed for the next show.
lines.speaker: Liv
